subject: gk
question: In which of the following places 'All India Muslim League' was founded?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Dhaka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **All India Muslim League** was founded in **Dhaka** on **December 30, 1906**.
 
• The founding session was held at the **Ahsan Manzil Palace**, which played a crucial role in the formation of the League.
 
• The primary objective of the League was to represent the interests of the **Muslim population** in India and to promote loyalty to the **British Government**.
 
• The League aimed to protect and advance the **political rights** and interests of the Muslims of India.
 
• The formation of the League marked a significant development in the political history of India, as it laid the foundation for the eventual creation of **Pakistan** in 1947.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lahore**__

 __
 
• Lahore was a significant city for the Muslim League, particularly for the **Lahore Resolution** of 1940, which called for the creation of independent states for Muslims in north-western and eastern zones of India, leading to the creation of Pakistan.
 
 
 
• **Karachi**__
 __
 
• Karachi became important later as the first capital of Pakistan, but it was not the founding place of the All India Muslim League.
 
 
 
• **Calcutta**__
 
 
• Calcutta (now Kolkata) was a prominent city during the British rule, but it was not associated with the founding of the All India Muslim League.
